note: Landmark coordinates for the mass cuts of the volume extractor (volume-extractor brief 4, item 4b), transcribed by Joe from the paper. Only the Y (up) coordinate is used by the cuts, as a horizontal plane.
source: Dumas R, Robert T, Chèze L, Verriest J-P (2015). Thorax and abdomen body segment inertial parameters adjusted from McConville et al. and Young et al. International Biomechanics 2(1):113-118. doi:10.1080/23335432.2015.1112244. Table 1, female, segment coordinate systems; reference lengths from Table 2
axes: X anterior, Y up (along the segment's long axis), Z right; negative Y is below the origin

abdomen.definition: below the 10th ribs (L1) and above the iliocristales (L4), p.117

mass_basis: p.116: segment masses are expressed assuming a uniform density of 1 g.cm-3, so the sheet's shares are volume shares of the reference women
